    • artifacts

      public List<BackupArtifactHandle> artifacts()
      Description copied from interface: EditorAutoBackupService
      Lists the artifacts currently present inside the host's configured auto-backup directory as opaque, permission-gated BackupArtifactHandles — regular files directly inside that directory only, never the directory's path, never recursive, and symbolic links are skipped.

      Requires the turboism.cubism.backup.observe permission: the handles it returns read artifact bytes, which crosses the same risk boundary as observing backup completions.

      Specified by:
      artifacts in interface EditorAutoBackupService
      Returns:
      the current backup artifacts, or an empty list when the host exposes no backup directory or the directory cannot be read

    • backupNow

      public CompletionStage<BackupRunResult> backupNow()
      Description copied from interface: EditorAutoBackupService
      Runs an immediate auto-backup: idempotent pack attach, then the host's updateAutoBackup trigger, then polls the backup directory and the document timestamps until the artifacts appear (or the timeout expires).

      The returned stage completes with a BackupRunResult on success, or exceptionally (sanitized) when the host call failed, the polling timed out, or the service is unavailable. The runtime separately publishes a detached BackupCompletedEvent. Sync targets registered via EditorAutoBackupService.registerSyncTarget(dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.backup.BackupSyncTarget) are invoked with the new artifacts after completion; target failures never fail the backup result.

      Specified by:
      backupNow in interface EditorAutoBackupService

    • backupAfterSave

      public CompletionStage<BackupRunResult> backupAfterSave(ProjectContentSnapshot saved)
      Description copied from interface: EditorAutoBackupService
      Backs up a just-saved document through the verified host saveDocument primitives, bypassing the host dirty condition (isModifiedAfterSaving && LastModified >= lastAutoBackupTime): right after a save the document is clean, so the host's updateAutoBackup path would not back it up.

      The saved snapshot is matched against the current pack file contents (getAllFileContents + IFileContent.getFile); the matched content is saved as <name>_backup<yyyy_MMdd_HHmm>.<ext> into the host backup directory (only there, never touching the original document), the artifact is polled for, and the returned stage completes with a BackupRunResult. The runtime separately publishes a detached BackupCompletedEvent. Sync targets registered via EditorAutoBackupService.registerSyncTarget(dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.backup.BackupSyncTarget) are invoked with the new artifact after completion; target failures never fail the backup result.

      Idempotent debounce: per-document saves within the 2-second debounce window are coalesced into the in-flight backup (the same stage is returned). Backup runs are serialized globally, so host saveDocument calls never run concurrently. Host calls run on the host UI thread and never block the save callback or the EDT.

      Specified by:
      backupAfterSave in interface EditorAutoBackupService
      Parameters:
      saved - the snapshot of the saved document
      Returns:
      the completed backup result, or a stage failed exceptionally when no pack content matches the snapshot, the host call failed, the artifact polling timed out, or the service is unavailable
